query:
UPDATE pota_references SET
                    pota_code = $2,
                    wwff_code = $3,
                    park_name = $4,
                    park_name_j = $5,
                    park_location = $6,
                    park_locid = $7,
                    park_type = $8,
                    park_inactive = $9,
                    park_area = $10,
                    longitude = $11,
                    latitude = $12,
                    maidenhead = $13,
                    "update" = $14
                WHERE pota_code = $1 OR (pota_code = '' AND wwff_code = $1)
